newsitem.title: USA: U. Michigan consumer sentiment prelim April 101.0.
newsitem.headline: U. Michigan consumer sentiment prelim April 101.0.

text.p: The University of Michigan's preliminary index of consumer sentiment for April rose to 101.0 compared with 100.0 for the final March index, financial market sources said on Friday.
The current conditions component rose to 116.7 in the preliminary April report against the 109.8 reading in the final March.
The expectations index fell to 90.9 in the April preliminary data versus 93.6 in the final March, the sources added.
The data are released only to paying subscribers.
